ape. In the third quarter, mortgage rates showed some relief, falling from 7.1% to 6.1% over the course of the quarter. However, this downward trend was short-lived, and mortgage rates rebounded to over 7.0% by late October. This reversal occurred despite the Federal Reserve's 50 basis point rate cut in September. With the mortgage rate bounce back, homeowners remain locked in to existing low-rate mortgages, and home buyers continue to face affordability constraints. This dynamic has translated into seasonally adjusted annual sales pace of under four million homes, as compared to the decade average of over five million.
